weather_report:
In the quiet hours of the early morning, Boston lies shrouded in a delicate veil of rain and shifting fog. The air, heavy with the scent of moisture, carries a promise of renewal. While the temperature dips comfortably around 63, the encroaching clouds conspire to wrap the city in a soft, gray embrace. There’s a gentle northeast breeze whispering through the streets, inviting the discerning observer to linger in the embrace of this serene yet somber atmosphere as the fog dances softly in the corners of the city.

As the day unfolds, the likelihood of rain continues, with sporadic showers lingering until the afternoon, when the burden of clouds may release their grip just enough for the possibility of glimpsing a muted sun. By the time the clock approaches mid-afternoon, temperatures will rise ever so slightly, hinting at the warmth of 71, while the fog insists on leaving its presence felt. Dressing for this day leans toward the pragmatic; a light rain jacket or an umbrella will keep one shielded from the lingering rains, and a cozy scarf might provide a touch of comfort against the cool breezes. 

While the outlook offers a sense of calm and introspection, exploring a quiet café or bookshop can provide the perfect sanctuary amidst the patter of rain outside. Alternatively, a brisk walk through the mist-laden streets, feeling the pulse of the city come alive under the shroud of fog, will undoubtedly awaken one’s spirit. As the day draws forth, let the weather set the tone for a moment of reflection and peaceful enjoyment.
